provenance.method: lesson notes written from the NERDC 2025 scheme of work outline; every week keeps its scheme topic and bullets as the teaching spine

topics.title: My name and myself
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to state their names.
The pupils should be able to say their age.
The pupils should be able to identify their sex.

Introduction:
We have all been given names by our parents.
Today we will learn to talk about ourselves.

Content:
Your name is what people call you.
Your age is how old you are.
A boy is a male child.
A girl is a female child.

Class activity:
Each pupil will stand up and say their name and age.

Evaluation questions:
What is your name?
How old are you?
Are you a boy or a girl?

Summary:
We can all say our names and ages.

topics.title: My family
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to list members of their family.
The pupils should be able to state roles at home.

Introduction:
Every pupil lives with a family.
Today we will learn about our families.

Content:
Father is the man in the family.
Mother is the woman in the family.
Brother is a male sibling.
Sister is a female sibling.

Class activity:
Draw your family members and say what they do.

Evaluation questions:
Who is your father?
Who is your mother?
What does your father do?

Summary:
We all have families with different roles.

topics.title: Good manners at home
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to greet elders properly.
The pupils should be able to say thank you.

Introduction:
We show good manners at home.
Good manners make our elders happy.

Content:
Greet your parents in the morning.
Say thank you when given something.
Keep your voice low at home.
Do not shout in the house.

Class activity:
Practice greeting and saying thank you with a partner.

Evaluation questions:
How do you greet your father?
When do you say thank you?
What is a good manner at home?

Summary:
Good manners make home happy.

topics.title: Good manners in school
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to greet the teacher.
The pupils should be able to sit nicely in class.

Introduction:
We are in school to learn.
Good manners help us learn well.

Content:
Greet your teacher when you enter class.
Sit straight on your chair.
Listen when the teacher is talking.
Do not disturb others in class.

Class activity:
Practice sitting properly and greeting the teacher.

Evaluation questions:
How do you greet your teacher?
How should you sit in class?
Why do we need good manners?

Summary:
Good manners help us learn in school.

topics.title: Honesty: telling the truth
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to tell the truth always.
The pupils should be able to explain why truth is important.

Introduction:
We must always tell the truth.
Truth makes people trust you.

Content:
Honesty means telling the truth.
Do not tell lies to your parents.
Do not hide things you broke.
Admit when you do something wrong.

Class activity:
Tell the class about a time you told the truth.

Evaluation questions:
What is honesty?
Should you tell lies?
What happens when you tell the truth?

Summary:
Honesty means always telling the truth.

topics.title: Care of things at home
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to keep their toys safe.
The pupils should be able to tidy their room.

Introduction:
We have many things at home.
We must take care of them.

Content:
Put your toys in the box after playing.
Keep your books on the shelf.
Tidy your room every day.
Do not break your things.

Class activity:
Practice tidying a mock room with toys and books.

Evaluation questions:
Where do you keep your toys?
How do you tidy your room?
Why should we care for our things?

Summary:
We must take care of things at home.

topics.title: Respect for elders
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to greet elders properly.
The pupils should be able to help elders.

Introduction:
Elders are older than us.
We must show respect to them.

Content:
Greet your elders when you meet them.
Help your parents carry things.
Use polite words like please.
Do not talk back to elders.

Class activity:
Practice helping elders with a bag of books.

Evaluation questions:
How do you greet your elder?
How can you help your mother?
Why must we respect elders?

Summary:
Respect makes elders happy.

topics.title: The national flag
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to identify the national flag.
The pupils should be able to name the colours.

Introduction:
Nigeria has a national flag.
The flag shows our country.

Content:
The flag has three colours.
Green stands for agriculture.
White stands for peace.
Green and white are the colours.

Class activity:
Draw the Nigerian flag with coloured pencils.

Evaluation questions:
What colour is the Nigerian flag?
What does green stand for?
What does white stand for?

Summary:
The Nigerian flag has green and white colours.

topics.title: Loving my country
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to say Nigeria is their country.
The pupils should be able to recite simple pledge words.

Introduction:
We are all Nigerians.
We love our country Nigeria.

Content:
Nigeria is our country.
We say the national pledge.
We stand for the national anthem.
We respect our leaders.

Class activity:
Practice saying the pledge together.

Evaluation questions:
What is your country?
What do we say in the pledge?
How do we show love for Nigeria?

Summary:
We love and respect our country Nigeria.

topics.title: Revision and assessment
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to recall term work.
The pupils should be able to answer quiz questions.

Introduction:
Today we will revise what we learned.
We will play a quiz game.

Content:
We learned about our families.
We learned about good manners.
We learned about honesty.
We learned about our country.

Class activity:
Answer questions about term work in groups.

Evaluation questions:
What is honesty?
How do you greet your teacher?
What are the colours of the flag?

Summary:
We have learned many good things this term.
